text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq's envoy to the U.N. meets in New York with the U.N. Under-Secretary-General and discusses with him implementation of the "oil-for-food" deal.
- Iraq's health minister urges meeting of the World Health Organisation which is being held in Pakistan to end the U.N. trade sanctions on Iraq.
- An Italian delegation representing trade unions arrives in Baghdad.
- Iraq comemorates on Sunday the Iranian shelling of a school in Baghdad in 1987.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- The Arab League discusses ways of lifting the trade sanctions on Iraq.
